GuestbookComment.title: GuestbookComment
GuestbookComment.description: A public guestbook comment left by a visitor on Luis Felipe Sandoval Charca's personal page.

authorName.description: Display name of the visitor or 'Anónimo'.

message.description: Short guestbook comment up to 200 characters without URLs.

visitorId.description: Anonymous client fingerprint token used for rate-limiting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was created.

LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: An immutable high-score entry for the Star Dash 2D arcade game.

playerName.description: Player display name (1 to 15 characters, filtered against offensive words and links).

score.description: Reasonable game score achieved in Star Dash (1 to 150000).

visitorId.description: Anonymous client token used to highlight the current player and rate-limit submissions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

/guestbook/{commentId}.description: Immutable guestbook entries ordered from newest to oldest. Only creation is permitted.

/leaderboard/{scoreId}.description: Immutable Star Dash leaderboard scores ordered by score descending. Only creation with reasonable scores is permitted.
